description: Update the system name in the Nx Witness VMS Web Admin at https://localhost:7001/static/index.html (credentials: admin/Admin1234!). Navigate to the Settings section (System Administration → General), find the system name field which currently shows 'GymAnythingVMS', change it to 'SecurityCentralVMS', and save the change. After saving, verify the new system name 'SecurityCentralVMS' appears in the web admin header.
